achievements.name: First Chamber
achievements.detail: Wake in Aperture and finish an opening test chamber with the portal gun.

achievements.name: Companion Cube
achievements.detail: Carry a Weighted Companion Cube onto a button so the chamber can continue.

achievements.name: Thermal Beam
achievements.detail: Aim a Thermal Discouragement Beam through portals until it opens the exit.

achievements.name: Light Bridge
achievements.detail: Cross a gap by walking a hard-light bridge you placed with portals.

achievements.name: Repulsion Gel
achievements.detail: Bounce on blue repulsion gel to reach a ledge the floor alone cannot.

achievements.name: Propulsion Gel
achievements.detail: Build a full run on orange propulsion gel and use that speed to clear a gap.

achievements.name: Conversion Gel
achievements.detail: Paint a bare surface with white conversion gel and place a portal on it.

achievements.name: Excursion Funnel
achievements.detail: Ride an excursion funnel and bend its path with portals to reach the exit.

achievements.name: Turret Down
achievements.detail: Tip a turret over so it powers down instead of firing.

achievements.name: Co-op Calibration
achievements.detail: Finish the cooperative calibration course with a partner.

achievements.name: Co-op Courses
achievements.detail: Clear every cooperative test course with another player.

achievements.name: Story Clear
achievements.detail: Finish every chapter of the single-player campaign.
